summary: Full end-to-end testing of Short Card by GlobalConnex. Backend pytest suite (9/9) passed and comprehensive Playwright UI tests covered landing (desktop + mobile 390), admin auth, dashboard, cards CRUD/lifecycle, activation flow (invalid/already-active/happy path), public redirect for valid/invalid/disabled codes, correction submission, businesses creation, history, settings (cs_whatsapp), and logout. Core lifetime-link guarantee flow works: PATCH destination updates /api/r/SC-0001 302 target immediately; disable serves 'Kartu Tidak Aktif' page; re-enable restores 302. Everything critical is functional. A few minor UI/design nits noted.

minor.issue: Returns HTTP 200 with an inline HTML fallback page instead of 404/410 for missing/disabled cards. Intentional UX design but not strictly REST semantic; user-facing pages render correctly.

ui_bugs.issue: Two small icon-only buttons next to the public URL appear blank in screenshots (Copy/Open icons not visible - likely low contrast white-on-white).
Empty input/select shown under 'BISNIS' label with no visible placeholder text when a business is already assigned; looks like leftover UI.

First screenshot showed dialog inputs looking empty even though values were filled - inputs likely have low-contrast text/placeholder rendering. Also DialogContent missing aria-describedby (a11y warning in console).

Console warning: 'Cannot update a component while rendering a different component' from AdminLogin during BrowserRouter render. Indicates a setState-in-render bug (likely calling navigate() during render instead of useEffect).

integration_issues.issue: Race condition suspected: first save after page load did not persist the typed value (config still returned old number) even though success toast shown. Second save worked. Likely the settings GET completes after user fill and overwrites the input, or the save button submits before state settles.

issues: Section text 'Varian Kartu' could not be located via exact-match text lookup (case/wording may differ); verify H2 label matches spec.

action_items: Fix AdminLogin setState-in-render warning (wrap navigate() / redirect logic in useEffect).
SettingsPage: guard against overwriting user-typed value while initial GET is in flight (or disable form until loaded).
CardDetailPage: verify Copy URL button icon visibility (contrast) and clean up the stray empty input under 'BISNIS' label when a business is already assigned.
Add aria-describedby to Edit Destination DialogContent (a11y).
Optional: consider returning HTTP 404/410 (with same HTML body) from /api/r/{code} for missing/disabled cards for correct REST semantics.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend /api/r/{code} returns 200 for not-found/disabled - acceptable but not semantically correct. Consider 404/410 while keeping HTML body.
Frontend AdminLogin triggers setState during render (React warning) - potential source of subtle bugs.
Race condition on SettingsPage fetch vs user edit - form should be disabled until initial data loads.
